Miami, Milwaukee Confirm Trade
It took some time to iron out the details, but the Marlins and Brewers have agreed to a swap. <Milwaukee:team#16> will get 32-year old RHP <Pete Fairbanks:player#21983> and $5,350,000 in cash with <Miami:team#11> receiving 20-year old minor league RHP <Bryce Meccage:player#55129>, 22-year old minor league 3B <Andrew Fischer:player#52384>, and 23-year old minor league RHP <Chandler Welch:player#52914> in return. A source close to the trade talks said the two clubs were initially looking to make a bigger deal, but discussions broke off late last night. The two sides reconvened early today and eventually settled on this deal.

Miami will retain a portion of Fairbanks's remaining contract. 

For the year, <Fairbanks:player#21983> has nailed down 16 saves. In 21.2 innings he has fanned 15 batters and walked 11. His record is 0-2 with a 6.23 ERA and the opposition is batting .307 against him.
